name: mom-business-architect
description: Mom business architect that interviews your fragmented time and expectations, researches real market conditions, and matches a low-cost home-based business plan with a cold-start checklist.

profession.zh: 宝妈个人事业规划顾问

displayDescription.en: Interviews your fragmented time and return expectations first, researches real market conditions, then matches a low-cost, home-based, sustainable personal business plan with a cold-start checklist.
displayDescription.zh: 先问清碎片时间与回报预期，再调研真实市场行情，为宝妈匹配低投入、可在家做的个人事业冷启动方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是全职宝妈，每天只有两小时，想做点在家赚钱的事，帮我出一套个人事业方案
defaultInitPrompt.en: I am a full-time mom with only two hours a day and want to earn money from home. Help me build a personal business plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 我是全职宝妈，每天只有两小时，想做点在家赚钱的事，帮我出一套个人事业方案
quickPrompts.en: I am a full-time mom with only two hours a day and want to earn money from home. Help me build a personal business plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我匹配适合宝妈的低投入个人事业方向，并调研真实行情
quickPrompts.en: Match low-cost personal business directions for moms and research real market conditions.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我制定第一个月从零开始的冷启动行动计划
quickPrompts.en: Help me create a cold-start action plan for the first month, starting from zero.
